name: AVANT GARDE CLEANROOM & ENGG. SOLUTIONS PVT LTD
india_angle: Avant Garde Cleanroom & Engg. Solutions Pvt Ltd is headquartered in Delhi and has a significant presence across India, providing services to major semiconductor companies.
summary: Avant Garde Cleanroom & Engg. Solutions Pvt Ltd specializes in providing turnkey MEP and cleanroom solutions tailored for semiconductor fabs and advanced technology facilities. They offer comprehensive services including HVAC systems, cleanroom envelopes, and process chilled water systems, serving major clients like Micron Technology and Foxconn Technology.
